theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  classical
  intro ϑ
  induction ϑ with
  | zero => exact fun h => absurd h (Nat.lt_irrefl 0)
  | succ ϑ_sub_1 ih =>
    cases ϑ_sub_1 with
    | zero =>
      -- `ϑ = 1`: the multilinear combination of the two rows is an affine line
      simp only [zero_add, zero_lt_one, forall_const]
      intro u hP
      simp_rw [multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation (F := F) (u := u),
        prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F)
          (P := fun r => Δ₀(affineLineEvaluation (u 0) (u 1) r, MC) ≤ e),
        Nat.cast_one, ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul] at hP
      rw [show u = finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) from by
        funext i
        match i with
        | 0 => rfl
        | 1 => rfl]
      exact hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) hP
    | succ ϑ_sub_2 =>
      -- `ϑ >= 2`: fold the last coin into an affine line between the two half word stacks
      intro _ u hP
      let ϑ' : ℕ := ϑ_sub_2 + 1
      let U₀ : WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ')) ι := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ') u).1
      let U₁ : WordStack A (Fin (2 ^ ϑ')) ι := (splitHalfRowWiseInterleavedWords (ϑ := ϑ') u).2
      have hrec (r : Fin (ϑ' + 1) → F) : multilinearCombine u r =
          multilinearCombine (affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ (r (Fin.last ϑ'))) (fun i => r i.castSucc) :=
        multilinearCombine_recursive_form (ϑ := ϑ') u r
      simp_rw [hrec] at hP
      let R_star_set := R_star_tensor MC (m := ϑ') (e := e) (ε := ε) U₀ U₁
      have hRstar : Pr_{ let r ← $ᵖ F }[r ∈ R_star_set]
          > (ε : ENNReal) / (Fintype.card F : ENNReal) := by
        refine prob_R_star_gt_threshold (MC := MC) (ϑ := ϑ') (u := u) (e := e) ?_
        rw [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (F := F) (ϑ := ϑ')
          (P := multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close (ϑ := ϑ') (MC := MC) (u := u) (e := e))]
        exact hP
      have hline : ∀ (r : R_star_set),
          jointProximityNat (u := affineLineEvaluation U₀ U₁ r.val) (e := e) (C := MC) := by
        intro r
        apply correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor (ih := fun w => ih (Nat.succ_pos _) w) (u := u)
      apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA (u := u) (e := e)
      refine h_interleaved_gaps (2 ^ ϑ') Nat.one_le_two_pow (⋈|U₀) (⋈|U₁)
        (lt_of_lt_of_le hRstar (Pr_le_Pr_of_implies ($ᵖ F) _ _ fun r hr => hline ⟨r, hr⟩))
